biography.value:
Description

A white spiny dog-like creature stares you down with her blue glowing eyes.

Defense

AC 22, touch 15, flat-footed 17 (+5 dex, +7 natural)

hp 92 [128] (8d10+48), fast healing 5;

Fort +12, Ref +11, Will +7

DR 5/evil; Immune Bleed, Daze, Death Effects, Holy, Mind-affecting, Outsider traits, Petrification/Statue, Sickening; Resist Lightning 10, Fire 10; SR 18;

Offense

Speed 40 ft.; Fly 100 ft. (average)

Melee Bite +15 (1d8+6 plus 1d4 holy dmg and trip), 2 Claws +14 (1d6+6)

Special Attacks Holy Bite, Impaled Pounce, Rake (2 claw +14, 1d8+6), Throat-Rip

Statistics

Str 22, Dex 20, Con 22, Int 10, Wis 16, Cha 10

Base Atk +8; CMB +14 (+18 trip); CMD 29 (33 vs. trip)

Feats Combat Reflexes, Iron Will, Stand Still, Weapon Focus (Bite)

Skills Acrobatics +16, Intimidate +11, Knowledge (Planes) +11, Perception +18 (22 by tracking), Stealth +16, Swim +17; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Survival when tracking by scent

Languages Celestial

description.value: Special attack listed in the source statblock: Rake (2 claw +14, 1d8+6).

effect: Two rakes; their dice are larger than the ordinary claws.

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a swift action, a forgiven conformity can choose to have an additional 1d6 holy damage onto her bite damage for 1 round.

effect: For one round enable Holy Bite on bite rolls; do not replace the ordinary 1d4 holy.

description.value: A forgiven conformity can make a full attack (including its rake attack) when she makes a charge attack, she also deals double damage with her tusks (bite).

effect: Charge and full attack including rake; double the bite, not extra energy dice. Use claws and rakes as part of this full attack.

description.value: As a full-round action, a forgiven conformity can deliver a coup de grace against a helpless opponent. If the victim survives the attack, she must succeed on a Fortitude save (DC 10 + damage dealt) or dies. Opponents killed in this manner cannot be raised, but Arise, Full-Life, or the like can restore the slain creature to life.

effect: Only a helpless foe: automatic critical hit. A surviving target rolls Fortitude DC 10 + actual damage or dies. Ordinary Raise cannot restore a victim killed this way; Arise or Full-Life can.

saveDCs.raw: No printed DC; generated from default monster DC.

effect: On a qualifying Bite hit roll against CMD, without provoking. Failure does not trip the attacker.

description.value: Until the start of the next turn after charging.
